title: JSFL: fl.createDocument() missing — cannot create new empty document
description: In packages/authoring-ui/src/jsfl/runtime.ts, fl.createDocument() is missing from the fl proxy. Flash 8 JSFL fl.createDocument(type?) creates a new empty document. Fix: add fl.createDocument() that creates a new empty document with default properties (550x400, 12fps, white background). The runtime currently wraps a single RuntimeState — new documents would need to reset state to defaults. Look at how the document is initialized to understand what a 'new empty document' means in this context.
